title: Scrub credentials and author-server details from tracked files
description: docs/PRODUCTION_QUICK_REFERENCE.md (around lines 425-438) holds the plaintext CourtHive/TMX admin email and password, the Club Wrapped access password, the admin username, the server IP and the SSH key path. COURTHIVE_SETUP.md holds an older real password. The repository is public. Jim rotates the CourtHive admin password on the server first (his action, not the agent's); this work item then removes every credential and author-specific server detail from tracked files, replacing them with placeholders and a pointer to where the operator keeps the real values. docker-compose.courthive.yml's hardcoded database username and password is removed or parameterised here too. This closes item #1 of docs/TECH_DEBT_AUDIT_2026-07.md.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Mechanical, well-specified edits across a known list of files.

acceptance_criteria: Jim has confirmed the CourtHive admin password was rotated before this item is marked complete
No plaintext password, access code or secret remains in any tracked file (verified by grepping tracked files for the old values without printing them)

The production server IP, the SSH key path and /opt paths are replaced by variables or placeholders in docs and in scripts/deploy-app.sh, scripts/deploy-digitalocean.sh, scripts/download-database.sh and scripts/import-tennis-players.sh; the scripts read SERVER / SSH_KEY / REMOTE_PATH from the environment or an untracked file and fail with a clear message when unset
docker-compose.courthive.yml contains no hardcoded database username or password
docs/TECH_DEBT_AUDIT_2026-07.md item #1 is marked done with the date

notes: Never echo a secret value into a log, commit message or work-item file while doing this.
The Wrapped access password was accepted as decorative in the audit; remove the value from the doc anyway, since other clubs will set their own.
The author's own deploy scripts must keep working for jim.tennis via an untracked scripts/.deploy.env (add to .gitignore).

testing_requirements: Run each modified script with the variables unset and confirm it exits non-zero with a helpful message
git grep for the old default database password and the server IP returns nothing in tracked files

context.user_story: As a club evaluating the project, I want the public repository to contain no live credentials so that I can trust it.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
